## Steps to Reproduce
1. Build and release the APK of the app.
2. Keep opening and closing it (Fully close it and clear it from the stack)
3. You shall see that the expected results don't seem to work.

**Expected results:**
The widgets in the `TabBarView` need to be shown. 

**Actual results:**
Sometimes a blank screen is shown instead where the `TabBarView` is unresponsive (unable to swipe between the tabs).

<details>
<summary>Code sample</summary>

```dart
class CalculatorView extends StatefulWidget {
  const CalculatorView({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<CalculatorView> createState() => _CalculatorViewState();
}

class _CalculatorViewState extends State<CalculatorView> {
  final List<Tab> myTabs = const [Tab(text: "Resin"), Tab(text: "Jesmonite")];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return DefaultTabController(
      length: 2,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          leading: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
            child: Image.asset(Assets.logo),
          ),
          centerTitle: true,
          elevation: 4,
          shadowColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.2),
          backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
          title: const Text(
            "Calculator",
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: primaryColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          bottom: TabBar(
            labelColor: primaryColor,
            tabs: myTabs,
          ),
          actions: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
              child: IconButton(
                  onPressed: () {},
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.school_rounded,
                    color: primaryColor,
                  )),
            )
          ],
        ),
        body: const TabBarView(children: [TestView(), TestView2()]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class TestView extends StatelessWidget {
  const TestView({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      color: Colors.amber,
    );
  }
}

class TestView2 extends StatelessWidget {
  const TestView2({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      color: Colors.blue,
    );
  }
}


```
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Logs</summary>

**flutter run** 
Unable to run flutter since it only appears sometimes when closing and restarting the app. Never happened in a debug apk or while running from the console.
